newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares trade lower on poll rumours.
newsitem.headline: French shares trade lower on poll rumours.

text.p: French shares were lower at midday on Thursday, weighed down by profit-taking and rumours that private opinion polls show a small majority for the centre-right government in the upcoming parliamentary election.

The losses were briefly extended after an erroneous statement from the Bank of France that it was increasing its intervention rate after a money market tender. Prices returned to their prior levels when the announcement was corrected.
At 1200 GMT, the CAC-40 blue chip index was down 1.31 percent at 2,749.95. Dealers said there was profit-taking ahead of the end of the May Bourse account on Friday.
